caps_and_model: No change to actual full24row/B12N44/original17/input2 epoch, same frozen pool/2node/256events/provider1m/records2/row_trials64/instances1, matching modes, fullfallback or native20/512/failure55/once. Diagnostic copy/write/hook costs charged in same future Root window.
error_semantics: No catches added. Native/guard/provider/consumer/hash/copy/phase/capture errors propagate. Missing stage/summary never means zero or absent call. No per-callback budget reset.

new_required_kwarg.name: capture_provider_summary
new_required_kwarg.ordinal: Exact locally incremented provider callback ordinal1 or2. No hook beyond2; scientific callbacks never capped.
new_required_kwarg.scope: Diagnostic returned-scalar observation only, not a fresh full provider receipt/offer/consumer admission/state/proof or runtime acceptance. Callback failures propagate unchanged.
new_required_kwarg.value: EXACT raw object returned by provider build_family_batch, passed directly: no copy/hash/protocol/envelope inspection before hook. Root-owned callback reads only fixed bounded scalar metadata; no mutation/retention of returned full object, scientific calls or unbounded traversal.

result_wire: Exact existing ROOT-receiver-inference-evidence-v1 and all inherited fields/statuses, only version changed. No counter/summary/output/failurewriter field added by helper. Root owns separate bounded capture slots/readout.
signature: run_receiver(*, language, base_semantics, marked_semantics, modules, frozen_inventory, matching_mode, tick, phase, capture_provider_summary)

stages.beyond_limits: Only extra diagnostic phase/hook writes omitted. Actual provider/consumer call, old copies/hash/log/envelope/return and all errors unchanged and unconditional.
stages.clock: Helper never reads a clock; Root phase is sole native sample/writer endpoint. Stage entry is not exclusive timing, active frame, accepted receipt, completed snapshot assertions or failure cause.
consumer_placement: Cj_DELEGATE_RETURN directly after raw delegate return.
Cj_CALLBACK_READY immediately before original return value.
stages.order_scope: Not one artificial total ordering: C2 CONTINUATION may precede P2 thenC3 BATCH in second selection; noContinuation may reach P2 beforeC2. Keep native observed order and per-callback groups/ordinal evidence.
provider_placement: Ordinal increments at entry, no clock read by helper.
Old first-only BEFORE_PROVIDER remains before supplied current-state/decision copy.
Pj_ENTER directly before build_family_batch (after supplied copy).
Pj_DELEGATE_RETURN next statement after actual delegate return, before copy/hash.
Unchanged copy(value), old first-only AFTER_PROVIDER, envelope check and provider report hash/log.
Pj_CALLBACK_READY immediately before original return value.
search_placement: SEARCH_RETURN_OBSERVED immediately after engine.search returns, before afterSnapshot.
POSTSEARCH_SNAPSHOT_READY immediately after afterSnapshot, before unchanged full root/stack/pool assertions.
